annotations.title: Forecast one run of a recipe

description: Says what one full or refresh run of a registered recipe would ask of its sources, before anything is started: per-source request ceilings, runtime at the ceiling, platform spend, and the projected bytes and cost. Warnings name what would slow or block the run. Example: {"recipe_id": "…", "recipe_digest": "…", "mode": "full"}. Returns {recipe_id, recipe_digest, mode, sources, totals, warnings}. Starts nothing and costs nothing. Use it after register_recipe and before start_run on any source that pages or makes one request per row.
name: forecast_recipe
title: Forecast one run of a recipe
